node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate linear-product paired involution gate
node.closure: one coefficient-free 6 x 3 paired-product involution gate, a symbolic fixture deletion, and a positive linear-product branch cut
node.statement: For every negative coordinate packet, and every positive packet whose product ratio reduces to degree at most one, conjugating source negation by the nonconstant Mobius edge-product map gives one projective involution on product values. If (y_i,z_i) are the products at the six source-label pairs, the rows [y_i z_i,-(y_i+z_i),-1] have rank at most two. Two antisymmetric pairs (u,-u),(v,-v) with u^2!=v^2 force all six pairs to be antisymmetric. This symbolically deletes the exact fixture over every odd field in both in-scope lanes. Any remaining positive realization has genuinely quadratic product ratio. Other packet graphs and the coordinate orientation remain open.
